assay: bulk poly(A)+ RNA-seq, mouse quadriceps, NovaSeq 100 bp PE (S4.25.p1, S4.26.p1)
sample_inclusion: male mice 13-15 weeks; MM (WT littermate) and VV (CaMKIIgamma M281V/M282V knock-in); sedentary or single bout of submaximal treadmill exercise (350 m), muscle collected 3 h after exercise; mice not finishing the protocol excluded; n = 4 per group (S4.23.p1, FIG3 legend b)
primary_estimand: acute transcriptional response of quadriceps to one bout of submaximal exercise (exercised vs sedentary, 3 h post) within each genotype, MM (WT) and VV (S2.3.p1, FIG3 c)
planned_contrasts: MM exercised vs MM sedentary (S2.3.p1; paper: 582 genes q < 0.05)
VV exercised vs VV sedentary (S2.3.p1; paper: 216 genes q < 0.05, 180 shared with MM)
MM exercised vs VV exercised (S2.3.p2, S4.26.p2; genes over 2 sigma fed to IPA, no q-value count reported)
repeated_measure_unit: none; independent mice, one quadriceps each
normalization: Tophat -> Stringtie -> Cuffdiff v2.2.1 FPKM (GEO data_processing)
paper_method: Cuffdiff v2.2.1 per-genotype exercised vs sedentary (GEO data_processing; S4.26.p1 defers to Tables S2-4)
